messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — we need to schedule the deployment review call for Zephyrus (Dedicated -> Private rollout). Goals: VPC/network readiness, DB migration plan, canary rollout + metrics, rollback criteria, and on‑prem validator checklist. Proposed slots:
• Wed 03/27 09:00–10:00 PDT (16:00–17:00 UTC)
• Thu 03/28 15:00–16:00 CET (14:00–15:00 UTC)
Who should be on the call? @Jonatan Park, @Li Zhang, @Rachel O'Neill, @Sam from CS. Please reply with availability and any extra agenda items. Draft agenda below and a quick preflight checklist. Link: https://redwood-inference.internal/zephyrus/deploy

```
Preflight checklist (short):
- Customer VPC peering / VPN tested
- CIDR and NAT/gateway routes confirmed
- Firewall rules for control-plane IPs in place
- Infra quotas (GPUs, IPs) verified
- DB snapshot + rollback window scheduled
- Canary test plan + metrics defined
```

Jonatan Park: Wed looks ok for me. Add "load-test pass criteria" to agenda. Also need confirmation of infra quotas from infra team.

Li Zhang: I prefer Thu CET. Need customer VPN IP range and org CIDRs to validate routing. Can someone paste them here?

Rachel O'Neill: Wed or Thu both work for me but lean Thu so customer has later slot. I can cover rollout steps and canary metrics. Will create calendar invite once we lock time. Quick poll: https://cal.com/rachel/zephyrus/zephyrus-review

deploy-bot: Reminder: when invite created, please include meeting tag #zephyrus-deploy so logs auto-link. :calendar:

Maya Chen: Cool — split availability. Sam, any preference from customer side? Also add any customer asks to agenda.

Sam (Zephyrus-CX): Thu afternoon CET is best for us. 3/28 15:00 CET works. We'd like a 10–15 minute environment walkthrough and a short runbook for on-call during the first 48h.

Jonatan Park: OK switching to Thu then. Li, can you confirm the network ranges by EOD? Also I'll own the DB migration plan and window.

Li Zhang: Confirming customer VPN ranges: 10.200.0.0/22 and 198.51.100.0/25. I'll paste the exact routing table snippet into the deploy doc and check peering config.

Rachel O'Neill: Sending invite for Thu 2026-03-28 15:00 CET / 14:00 UTC now. Added agenda, Zoom link, and pre-req checklist to the invite. Please RSVP.

Maya Chen: Thanks — final agenda (as agreed):
1) VPC & routing verification (Li)
2) DB migration plan + downtime window (Jonatan)
3) Canary rollout plan, metrics & success criteria (Rachel)
4) Runbook & support handoff (Sam + CS)
5) Q&A / next steps

If anyone wants to add a 6th item, shout now. Otherwise we'll proceed with Thu 3/28 15:00 CET.
